tasks.short: Hand out current approved samples and literature

steps.what: Check product samples and literature against the current campaign pack and intended audience
Distribute product samples or literature and answer immediate questions in person

tasks.design: Use the existing current-pack view in {DOCS} to check the materials, then distribute them in person. A template does not remove the handling or conversation, and an already indexed campaign pack offers no further lookup saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work is physical distribution and situational communication.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability changes those actions in this design.
tasks.still_hard: Judge whether a sample is suitable and whether an explanation has been understood.
tasks.human_edge: Notice hesitation and respect a refusal.

ambition.what: No change to distribution capacity is claimed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: handing out physical materials requires handling and engagement; a current document index may already cover the lookup.

assumptions: Boundary is one distribution round including its actual material check, not campaign authoring or order taking. No distribution log is assumed.
Campaign staff produce the current pack with campaign id, validity, product identity and audience restrictions. The vendor compares physical labels in s1; missing or expired material is withheld.
Native current-pack lookup is tested first and assumed already adequate. Its small retained time is not a saving.
The pack checked in s1 is the exact pack used in s2; changed material requires another check. This is a distribution decision, not approval of an author's internal save.
All shares are focal vendor labour and are illustrative decomposition, not measured times. No new helper or ongoing upkeep exists.
unknowns: Whether campaign packs are already indexed and current.
research_questions: Does any actual repeated lookup remain after testing the native pack view?

already_counted.description: Material checks and physical distribution remain fully counted.

incremental.description: No new helper or maintenance process.

approvals.approved_version: checked distribution pack from s1; any material change voids it

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Both the material check and physical distribution remain; no unnecessary record or additional digital baseline is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Check the route and customer stops before travel to sell merchandise
Circulate among potential customers and travel to deliver or sell merchandise

tasks.design: Keep the existing navigation application in {OTHER} for the route check. Its routing computation is already performed today, and neither that runtime nor an unmeasured distance reduction is counted as labour saved.
tasks.previous_blocker: Movement between selling locations remains physical.
tasks.enabler_now: Native navigation already supplies routing; no extra helper is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Access restrictions, safe stopping and finding receptive customers.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt the round to actual conditions.

ambition.what: No change in route capacity is claimed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: navigation applications calculate routes, while actual travel and access checks remain with the traveller.

assumptions: Boundary is the selling round's route check and physical movement; the actual customer sale is a separate task. There is no invented trip report.
The dispatcher or vendor already supplies stop locations and visit constraints to the navigation application in OTHER. Entering or correcting those locations and checking access is retained in s1.
Native routing is already used, so configuration does not remove the existing five-share route check. No travel time reduction is assumed without comparable route measurements.
All steps are focal labour. No additional software or upkeep is introduced.
unknowns: Whether any route construction is still manual.
research_questions: What portion of s1 remains repeated manual stop entry after native favourites are used?

already_counted.description: Route input correction and physical travel remain.

incremental.description: No new helper; existing navigation maintenance is unchanged.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The explicit route lookup remains unchanged because native routing is already present; travel has no evidenced reduction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Use current product facts during personal selling

steps.what: Find current merchandise facts and permitted services offers for customer questions
Persuade customers through a personal discussion of merchandise or services

tasks.design: Configure a small product and offer view in {ECOMMERCE} for the questions actually asked on the round. The vendor checks the displayed validity and suitability, then conducts the sales conversation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the applicable item or offer interrupts the conversation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native catalogue filters and saved views can expose approved facts without generating claims.
tasks.still_hard: Understand needs and avoid promising a product cannot meet them.
tasks.human_edge: Earn trust and recognise a customer's refusal.

ambition.what: No new sales authority is proposed.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native catalogue filters can reduce searching for approved product attributes and current offers.

assumptions: Boundary covers persuasion and its real product lookup. Customer orders and payments follow the purchase decision in separate transaction workflows; this task makes no order, message or invented sales-note write.

Merchandising staff already maintain SKU, description, price, offer expiry and limitations in the catalogue. The vendor supplies the question and checks relevance in s1; missing facts require manual lookup within retained time.
Test native favourites and filters first. The cut removes repeated navigation and comparison across catalogue pages, retaining product choice, validity checking and unsupported questions.

All baseline time is focal vendor labour; catalogue ownership is unchanged and excluded. Incremental upkeep covers the vendor checking favourites after catalogue changes. These are unmeasured task estimates.
unknowns: Frequency of catalogue lookups during a selling round.
research_questions: Can the actual common questions be answered from existing catalogue fields?

already_counted.description: Fact suitability checks and all personal selling remain.

incremental.description: Check saved product views when offers change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central gross 5.2 less upkeep 0.3 gives 4.9. Cautious case: offers have sparse metadata so s1 retains 75%, yielding 2 gross less 0.3 upkeep; the stated low is below 1.7. Conversation stays fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Replenish selling supplies with checked purchase orders

steps.what: Count supplies and assess damaged or unsellable stock
Look up outstanding purchase quantities and current supplies prices
Prepare the supplies purchase order using selected items and quantities
Check and authorise the final supplies order against demand, budget and delivery needs
Send the authorised purchase order to the supplies supplier

tasks.design: Configure the open-order view and repeat-order form in {PROCUREMENT}. Physical stock checks and quantity choices remain with the vendor, who checks the finished purchase snapshot before its separate submission.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reopening orders and reselecting repeat items adds clerical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native open-order filters and repeat-order forms reuse existing supplier item fields.
tasks.still_hard: Judge demand, usable stock and substitution quality.
tasks.human_edge: Balance cash tied up in stock against likely selling demand.

ambition.what: Revisit replenishment quantities for slow-moving selling items before placing the next order.

reach.learn: Supplier item identifiers and pack sizes.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: purchasing systems commonly expose open orders and repeat-order forms; physical stock quality and demand choices remain human.

assumptions: Boundary runs from physical supplies check to placing an order within the vendor's existing buying authority. Supplier fulfilment and payment are outside and unchanged.

The vendor counts stock in s1 and enters count, SKU and chosen quantity in s3. The purchasing records already contain supplier id, item id, pack size, price, delivery address and open-order quantity; supplier maintenance is existing work. Missing identifiers and changed packs are repaired manually within retained s2/s3 time.

Native configuration is tested before custom code. S2 removes repeated opening and adding open orders; s3 removes repeated item/address entry, retaining count capture and quantity selection. No saving is assigned to the one-share submission or ordinary form saves.

S4 is the actual purchase commitment decision after the final order exists, not a gate on saving the author's notes. Approval binds the exact supplier, lines, price and address snapshot; any edit requires a new check.
All shares are focal labour and unmeasured. No new supplier or supervisor labour is assumed; incremental allowance covers this vendor's saved-form checks.
unknowns: Existing repeat-order capability and vendor buying limits.
research_questions: Do item and pack identifiers remain stable across repeat orders?

already_counted.description: Stock handling, source capture, quantity decisions, corrections and release remain.

incremental.description: Check repeat-order forms after supplier pack or address changes.

approvals.approved_version: authorised purchase snapshot produced in s4 from final s3 draft; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Central cuts are 9 points in open-order lookup and 11.25 in form preparation; net is 19.25 after upkeep. Cautious case: open orders need full manual reconciliation and unstable packs leave s3 at 68% retained, giving 8 gross and 7 net. Physical checks and release remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The vendor still performs the selling round, with fewer interruptions for product and supplies screens.
reach: Purchasing clerk: maintain repeat-order item references.
role.ambitious_version: Make replenishment decisions with current outstanding orders while preserving personal selling and physical handling.
